org.portico.lrc.management

Class Federation

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.management.Federation
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Iterable<Federate>, SaveRestoreTarget

    public class Federation
extends Object
implements SaveRestoreTarget, Iterable<Federate>
    This class provides a bunch of methods for obtaining information about a federation. Very little information is stored in this class, it mainly just provides a facade/helper to expose the information stored by the LRC on other federates.
